notes: First-pass baseline. CI parses .next/build-manifest.json (produced by any `next build`) and asserts per-route first-load JS against bundle.maxKb. The first enforcement pass sets bundle.maxKb to current+5% then ratchets down. To ratchet, run `npm run build`, inspect `.next/build-manifest.json`, and update this file in the same PR that intentionally changes a baseline. See docs/perf.md.

ratchetHistory.reason: First-pass baseline captured from a partial `next build` (Turbopack, build errored at prerender due to a fake Clerk key; only shared chunks are on disk). Shared first-load JS is 431 kB; cap set at 431+5% = 453, rounded to 460 to absorb variance.
Initial first-pass guess before baseline was captured. Superseded by the 460 kB entry.
